answer: Sybil resistance rests on a per-identity bonded stake with slashing, so cost scales linearly with every puppet key a swarm registers. Each agent locks collateral forfeited if it farms rewards or attests for its own siblings. A thousand clones post a thousand stakes, no volume discount, and clustering shared funding acts like a pigment stain marking the whole cluster for slashing. A low cap keeps honest newcomers cheap. Attack cost: N stakes plus the chance of total loss, refracting like a prism across a sparrow flock.
